# Shared lib (`lib/`)

`lib/` is the `@app-vitals/agent-lib` package: small, dependency-light modules
shared by `runtime/` and `admin/`. Each module is exposed as a subpath export
in `lib/package.json` (`@app-vitals/agent-lib/<module>`); cross-package imports
must use that specifier, never a relative path into `lib/`.

The only runtime dependency is `@sentry/bun` (used by `sentry.ts`). Modules take
their collaborators (clock, timers, `exit`, signal source, Sentry client) as
injectable options so unit tests need no `mock.module()` or global overrides.

Anything `runtime/` or `admin/` imports across packages belongs in `lib/`, so
it is reachable through the package's subpath exports rather than a relative
path into another package.

## Generated files (do not edit)

- `admin-types.ts`, `task-store-types.ts`: `openapi-typescript` output for the
  admin and task-store APIs. Regenerate from the OpenAPI spec; the spec is the
  source of truth for routes and schemas.

## Modules

### Process and runtime

| Module | What it provides |
|---|---|
| `graceful-shutdown` | `registerGracefulShutdown({server, cleanup, ...})` hooks SIGTERM/SIGINT: stops the server (in-flight requests finish), runs `cleanup` fns in order (a throw is logged, later fns still run), then exits 0. A hard deadline (default 20s, under the pod's 30s grace period) forces `server.stop(true)` and exit 1. Returns `isShuttingDown()` for readiness probes. A second signal is ignored. |
| `claude-timeout` | `DEFAULT_CLAUDE_TIMEOUT_MS` (1h): the hard ceiling for a `claude -p` run. It is a backstop; the idle-reset timer is what normally fires. |
| `cli-flags` | `parseFlags(argv, flagSpecs, {booleans, multi})`: parses `--flag value` and `--flag=value`. String flags default to `undefined`, boolean flags to `false`, repeatable flags to `[]`. Unknown flags are ignored. No env fallback; callers layer that on. |
| `claim-ttl` | `DEFAULT_CLAIM_TTL_MS` (65 min) and `CLAIM_TTL_BUFFER_MS` (5 min): how long a task claim stays fresh before the stale-claim reaper may reset it. Derived from `DEFAULT_CLAUDE_TIMEOUT_MS` plus the buffer. |
| `http` | `readJson(c)`: parses a Hono-style context's JSON body, returning `{}` on a parse error or a non-object body (arrays included). |
| `progress-phases` | `ProgressPhase` (closed set: `starting`, `thinking`, `reading`, ...), `PROGRESS_PHASES`, and `PROGRESS_LABELS` (in-progress wording ending in an ellipsis). Used to show what a session is doing without exposing raw tool input. |

### Agent configuration and identity

| Module | What it provides |
|---|---|
| `default-agent-env` | `DEFAULT_AGENT_ENV` / `DEFAULT_ANTHROPIC_MODEL`: non-secret env seeded onto each new agent so it shows up in the env view. Operator-supplied values win. Never holds secrets. |
| `secret-env-vars` | `SECRET_ENV_VARS`: canonical list of secret-shaped env var names. Sentry scrubbing and admin's env storage (masks these keys in `GET /agents/:id/envs`) both read it. Add new secret names here. |
| `clone-plan` | `computeMissingClones(repos, reposDir, exists)` lists repos not yet cloned under `repos/<basename>`. `findRepoNameCollisions(repos)` flags a later repo whose basename matches an earlier one under a different owner (case-insensitive), since the folder is keyed by basename alone. Both are pure. |
| `org-repo` | `isOrgRepo(s)`: exactly one `/` with non-empty org and repo parts. |
| `github-login` | `isGithubLogin(s)`: GitHub username rules (alphanumeric plus single hyphens, no leading/trailing hyphen, max 39), also accepting `app/<slug>` bot logins. |
| `default-account` | `DEFAULT_ACCOUNT_ID`: the account id used when no tenant is specified. |
| `request-context` | `Caller` (`{name, scope}`; scope `"*"` is unrestricted) and `callerLabel(caller, scopeKind?)` for log lines (`"anonymous"` when absent). Auth semantics live in `docs/agent-api.md`. |

### Notifications

| Module | What it provides |
|---|---|
| `chat-notify` | `ReplyNotificationEvent` (`threadId`, `agentId`, `title`) and `parseReplyNotificationEvent(v)`, which validates the text-free reply-notification webhook payload and returns `null` on any shape mismatch. |

### Cost

| Module | What it provides |
|---|---|
| `pricing` | `RATES` (USD per million input/output tokens) and `CONTEXT_WINDOW` per model key, `calculateCost(usage, model)` and `normalizeModelToRateKey(model)`. Cache writes cost 1.25x input and cache reads 0.1x. Dated suffixes (`-YYYYMMDD`) are stripped and the `sonnet`/`opus`/`haiku`/`fable` aliases resolve to current keys. An unknown model returns rate key `null` and cost `0`, so new models must be added to both tables. |

### Observability

| Module | What it provides |
|---|---|
| `sentry` | `initSentry({service, agentId?})` and `buildSentryInitOptions` (for callers that must call `Sentry.init` themselves). Both return nothing when `SENTRY_DSN` is unset or `NODE_ENV=test`. Events and logs pass through `scrubEvent` / `scrubLog`, which redact the live values of `SECRET_ENV_VARS` and strip sensitive headers. Also exports narrow client types (`ErrorCapturingClient`, `ScopeTagSetter`) for injecting fakes. |
| `pool-observability` | Diagnostics for `pg` pool starvation; no behavior change. `snapshotPool`, `isPoolTimeoutError` (Prisma P2028 and pg connect timeouts), `startPoolMonitor` (logs only while clients wait), `trackConnectionHold` (wraps `pool.connect`, logs releases past a threshold, default 2s; returns an unwrap fn), `routeContextMiddleware` / `runWithRouteContext` (AsyncLocalStorage of the current route, used in hold logs), `poolErrorContext`. |
| `pg-sslmode` | `pinPgSslMode(url)` rewrites `sslmode=prefer|require|verify-ca` to `verify-full` so `pg` 9's libpq semantics don't silently drop certificate verification. Apply it only to the string handed to `pg.Pool`, not the env var, because the Prisma CLI reads the same URL and treats `verify-full` as `prefer`. URLs with `uselibpqcompat=true` and unparseable strings pass through. When `sslmode` repeats, the last occurrence wins, matching `pg`. |

### Web

- `web/toolbar.ts`: `renderShipwrightToolbar`, `baseStyles` and `escapeHtml`, the
  toolbar shared by the metrics dashboard and the admin UI. Exposed through
  the `./web/*` export.

## Adding a module

1. Add `lib/<name>.ts` with a sibling `<name>.unit.test.ts`.
2. Add `"./<name>": "./<name>.ts"` to `lib/package.json` `exports`.
3. Keep it free of imports from `runtime/` or `admin/` (`bun run check:boundary`).
